source: live thehyun.com, rendered in a browser
derivation: Webflow renders every cut on every grid and hides what fails an inventory condition with the class w-condition-invisible (display:none !important). Two conditions expose the quantity: the category grids hide the "sold out" badge when default-sku:ecSkuInventoryQuantity > 0, and /available-cuts hides the whole card unless the same quantity is > 1. Badge suppressed => qty >= 1; card shown on /available-cuts => qty >= 2.
meaning: 2 means "two or more" — the exact count above 1 is not observable from the page. 1 and 0 are exact.
